column2: ECU assigned to monitor and process PN Activation Criteria. At least one ECU per PN is an Activating ECU, but there may be others (depends on the architecture deployment)
ECU is a member of an activated PN. All members of networks supporting PNs are capable of being Activated ECUs
A set of conditions that result in the activation of a PN. These conditions are typically a combination of local inputs and / or serial data signals
A set of conditions that result in the deactivation of a PN
PN that is activated from within the ECU because its PN Activation Criteria was met
PN that is activated from outside the ECU
